title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Omigosh, a close-up chance to watch the Doctor at work. Finally, I'll get a glimpse of Rhodes Island's secrets! Huh? You just want me to tell you a scary story to keep you up? Seriously? Fine, two choices then: The Headless Burdenbeastman of the Barrens, or The Thousand-Year Curse of the Sargonian Tomb. Which one, Doc?

title: Talk 1
original: I never imagined I'd see two familiar faces from Wrankwood here. Nah, I'm not that interested in them personally, just curious on how they ended up on a pharma company's landship. They must have some kinda angle here!

title: Talk 2
original: What am I looking at, standing here on the bridge? Uh, I was just thinking how Rhodes Island's such a great place. Look, sealed spaces, high mobility, destinations unknown, everyone's using code names... doesn't it feel like a survival-slasher horror flick?!

title: Talk 3
original: I tried doodling a 'Slenderburdenbeastman' symbol on this corner of the corridor here, but no one's reacting to it when they walk by. Why? Not enough Columbians onboard? Nobody knows the legend?—Relax, I'll clean it up once my experiment's done.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: The device on my back's made of suspension cables and hover units, and I'm the only one with anything like it in Wrankwood. I met my master who taught me how to retrofit it on a little production. He spent whole days there with a jetpack on his back. Dunno where he went after production wrapped. Omigosh, you might have seen him in Sargon?

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Look! Timestamp three-seventeen, see how the vapor turns the smile in the makeup mirror into a spooky face—this clip's one of my best! I tried it at home once when I was a kid. All these people came by to talk about how great my drawings were, only to get a nasty shock. I just knew it was gonna be super effective.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I joined Greta's crew because she promised me artistic freedom, but that was another load of crap! Meeting Miss.Christine and Lucian gave me a lot of inspiration though. Don't you think it'd be fun to make a horror flick about a storm-cloudbeast exorcist?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Nah, I don't butt heads with my parents that much, I just don't like how stiff their pictures are. And I didn't like the path they laid out for me either. But... I guess I've got a long way to go before the skills and resources needed to put together a real spectacular movie.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: When I was starting out, I joined some little production crews, hoping to meet interesting people, but I ended up so busy I couldn't get a convo in... These days, at least I got you to lend me an ear whenever I come back onboard, Doctor.

title: Idle
original: Doctor? Oh, busy? Suits me, Tippi can take care of herself. Let's see if there's anything new to watch... Omigosh, an nonconformist Lungmen horror comedy... let's do this one!

title: Onboard
original: Live long and prosper! Tippi 'Skyriftwalker' Booker reporting for duty! Who, Doctor? Oh, Skyriftwalker's the code name I thought up for myself! Uh, that's not how you do code names here?

title: Watching Battle Record
original: The protag gets a videotape everyday, describing her life bit by bit, until one day the video shows her killing people... don't you think that fits the vibes in this recording? No? For reals?

title: Promotion 1
original: That's it? Pretty mid ceremony. No test or anything like that?

title: Promotion 2
original: I get another promotion? Does this mean I can go some places I wasn't allowed before?

title: Added to Squad
original: Omigosh, this a co-op mission? I'll get along real nice with everybody.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Ooh, just got a new idea! Let's try it out!

title: Depart
original: C'mon! Let's go see the wonderful sights waiting for us out there.

title: Begin Operation
original: An extra special spot we got here.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Finally my turn to make a move? I'm in a good spot!

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Spray gun and hover unit ready.

title: Deployment 1
original: Let's set the rigging!

title: Deployment 2
original: I've almost finished this piece. Just a sec!

title: In Battle 1
original: Some deep purple for a sense of mystery.

title: In Battle 2
original: Bit of dark red to get your heart pumping.

title: In Battle 3
original: A little lime green for a weird rotten vibe.

title: In Battle 4
original: The stage's set, now let's see how everyone performs!

title: 4-star Result
original: Now this is a perfect work of art! Lemme just tag my name in the corner here real quick.

title: 3-star Result
original: So much for Wrankwood war movies.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: That was an epic experience!

title: Operation Failure
original: Let me edit that op's recording. I might just come up with a new kind of horror flick.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: So I can't tag the corridors, but can I spraypaint my own dorm walls?

title: Tap
original: Keep on tapping the device on my back, and something scary just might pop out.

title: Trust Tap
original: Don't worry about me, if you're tied up. I can keep myself busy. Oh, you're done? Wanna watch a movie together?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Watch a New Year's blockbuster together? Sure—'Famous Columbian husband-and-wife producer-director duo collabs on joint production for war film...' Okay, Doctor, I don't mind going with you, but don't blame me if I fall asleep halfway in.

title: Greeting
original: Want me to spray some colors around to liven up the place and brighten your mood?

title: Birthday
original: I always had big parties as a kid. The adults would use them as an excuse to socialize, like with totally zero thought to what the birthday girl wanted. Wasn't the biggest fan. So for your birthday, I redecorated your room based on your favorite movies this year. What'cha think?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Rhodes Island's a proper pharma company, I've seen that with my own eyes—too bad it doesn't have the stories I got up here in my head. But Doc, you're full of mysteries, so I have to keep watching you for reference material. And who knows, you might even star in your own horror movie one day.
